summary: Vendor-favorable MSA with three material buyer risks: an auto-renewal trap with a 90-day opt-out window and 10% price-bump latitude (§ 2.2), front-loaded annual prepayment with no refund on termination (§ 4.1), and a 6-month liability cap (§ 11.1). Customer also lacks reciprocal IP indemnification (§ 10). Recommend negotiation before signature.

risks.title: Annual prepayment with no refund on termination
risks.description: Customer must pay the full annual fee upfront within 30 days and forfeits all prepaid amounts on early termination, shifting cash-flow risk entirely to the buyer.

evidence.quoted_text: All annual fees due in advance within thirty days of contract execution

risks.title: Auto-renewal with 90-day opt-out window
risks.description: Agreement auto-renews for 12-month terms unless non-renewal notice is given at least 90 days before the renewal date, and Vendor may raise renewal pricing by 10% each cycle.

evidence.quoted_text: Term auto-renews for successive 12-month periods unless either party provides written notice of non-renewal at least 90 days prior to the then-current renewal date

risks.title: Six-month fees liability cap
risks.description: Vendor's aggregate liability is capped at fees paid in the six months preceding any claim, which is well below market-standard 12-month mutual caps and may not cover realistic buyer damages.

evidence.quoted_text: Vendor's aggregate liability shall not exceed the fees paid by Customer in the six months preceding the claim

risks.title: One-way indemnification favoring Vendor
risks.description: Customer indemnifies Vendor but receives no reciprocal indemnification, including no IP indemnity for third-party claims that the Services infringe.

evidence.missing_concept: no mutual IP indemnification clause protecting Customer from third-party infringement claims against the Services

presence.quoted_text: Customer may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon one hundred eighty (180) days prior written notice
presence.concern: 180-day notice window is long and no refund of prepaid fees is permitted on termination.

presence.quoted_text: Term auto-renews for successive 12-month periods unless either party provides written notice of non-renewal at least 90 days prior to the then-current renewal date
presence.concern: 90-day opt-out window plus discretionary 10% renewal price increase.

presence.quoted_text: Vendor's aggregate liability shall not exceed the fees paid by Customer in the six months preceding the claim
presence.concern: Cap is 6 months of fees; market standard is 12 months mutual.

presence.quoted_text: Vendor is granted a worldwide, royalty-free license to use Customer Data to operate, maintain, and improve the Services, including to train and refine Vendor's machine learning models
All annual fees due in advance within thirty days of contract execution
presence.concern: Annual prepayment with no refund on termination shifts cash risk to buyer.

presence.quoted_text: Each party agrees to protect the other party's Confidential Information using the same degree of care it uses to protect its own confidential information
This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of California

suggestions: Negotiate liability cap to mutual at 12 months fees
Move from annual prepayment to net-30 invoicing
